prompt: Create a card component with multi-slot content projection. It should have slots for a header, body, and actions section. Use ng-content with select attributes. Include fallback content for the actions slot that shows a default 'Close' button. Also create a CardHeader component used as the selector for the header slot.

assertions.text: Uses <ng-content> with select attribute for multi-slot projection
Has at least 3 distinct ng-content slots (header, body, actions)
Includes fallback content inside at least one <ng-content> element
Creates a separate CardHeader component with its own selector
Components are standalone (no explicit standalone: true)
